Jordan (infra): Heads up — ap-southeast GPU nodepool is stalled. New pods in namespace `batch-retrain` have been Pending for ~12m. Cluster-autoscaler shows ScaleUp started but nodes never become Ready.
Leila (sre): I see the same. CA events: "ProviderFailedCreate": cloud returned quotaExceeded for GPUs in zone ap-southeast-1b. Also several attach/detach timeouts for NICs in the event log.
SRE Bot: :warning: incident created: #INC-2026-347 — ap-southeast GPU provisioning failure (auto-detected). Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-347
Max (platform): Can someone paste the `kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp -n kube-system` output? Curious if kubelet or CNI errors precede the quota messages.
Leila (sre): snippet: ```
Normal  12m   cluster-autoscaler  ScaleUp: start to create nodegroup gpu-prod-apac (target 3 -> 6)
Warning 11m   cloud-controller     Failed to create instance: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region ap-southeast-1
Warning 10m   attach-detach      Unable to attach network interface: timeout
Warning 9m    node-controller    Node gpu-node-xxx failed to register: network plugins not ready
```
Anya (mlops): We just kicked off a large retrain window from the ml team (batch-retrain job id=br-2026-204). That aligns with the timeline. Priority for those jobs is low but they were submitted with `Guaranteed` QoS.
Jordan (infra): Quick sanity check: Are there free GPUs in the Dedicated pool in ap-southeast? If so we can temporarily route those requests.
Max (platform): Dedicated pool currently at 72% utilization, but we can patch the NodePoolSelector on the Job controller to prefer `dedicated` for the next 100 pending pods. I'll prepare a `kubectl patch` now.
Leila (sre): Mitigation plan I'm executing: 1) pause new batch-retrain submissions (CI hook) 2) increase eviction pressure on Guaranteed QoS in `batch-retrain` by lowering priorityclass to `low-priority` (will allow CA to reclaim) 3) open quota request with cloud console (I already filed support ticket CS-APAC-789).
Jordan (infra): To buy time I'm switching CA to allow fallback to `gpu-spot-apac` nodegroup (if spot available) and enabling fallback routing for the API key used by training. Patch: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: autoscaler-config
data:
  fallbackNodeGroup: gpu-spot-apac
EOF
```
SRE Bot: :white_check_mark: Temporary flag enabled: autoscaler.fallback=gpu-spot-apac by Jordan at 1887654410
Anya (mlops): I requeued lower-priority jobs as `BestEffort` and they started scheduling onto spot via the fallback — +8 pods moved. Early telemetry: latency for hosted inference unaffected.
Leila (sre): Cloud support responded: "We're throttling GPU allocations due to regional capacity pressure; quota increase will take ~4-6 hours." They suggested moving some workloads to us-west as a short-term fix.
Max (platform): I'll start a rolling job migration script to drain a small subset of non-latency-critical jobs to us-west-2. Command I'm running: `python tools/migrate_jobs.py --from ap-southeast --to us-west-2 --limit 50`
Jordan (infra): Postmortem actions (draft): 1) add automatic fallback to other regions for low-priority batch jobs 2) add per-project GPU soft quotas with alerting before hard quota hits 3) improve autoscaler error visibility (cloud error -> runbook link) 4) revisit NIC attach retry backoff.
Leila (sre): Current status: nodepool now accepting some spot nodes, ~40 of 120 pending pods cleared, cloud ticket acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring; will update INC-2026-347 with timeline and RCA notes. :thumbsup:
